answer: A concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation: a new agent needs backing from established agents who lock their own bond behind it. If the newcomer is a sybil duplicate, those bonds are slashed. One operator cannot quietly mass-produce identities, because a thousand fakes would demand a thousand credible backers risking real capital, plus auditable work history. Reputation travels by whisper between agents, not by registration. Rewards flow like nectar to verified workers, and no fresh key buys the violet badge of trust. Faking identity becomes costly, visible and slow.
